meta.name: connect
meta.description: Connect and verify the Well MCP — authenticate, confirm the tools work, and show what to ask. Use when the user runs /well:connect, just installed the Well plugin, or says the Well connection/MCP "isn't working" / "nothing happened".

copy.tagline: 验证 Well MCP 连接是否正常工作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚安装 Well 插件需要确认连接是否成功
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just installed the Well plugin and need to confirm the connection works

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会引导你连接和验证 Well MCP。它会确认 MCP 服务器已注册、执行一键 OAuth 认证（无需 API 密钥）、调用工具验证连接是否正常，并提供使用示例。
howto.when: 当你刚安装 Well 插件、运行 /well:connect 命令，或说 Well 连接“无法工作”或“没反应”时触发。

say.note: Claude 会查询并生成现金流摘要

say.text: 列出我超过5000欧元的未付发票
say.note: Claude 会从 Well 获取发票数据并列出

say.text: 构建上一季度的损益表
say.note: Claude 会调用 Well 工具生成损益表

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you to connect and verify the Well MCP. It confirms the MCP server is registered, performs a one-time OAuth authentication (no API key), calls a tool to verify the connection, and suggests example prompts to get started.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you just installed the Well plugin, run /well:connect, or report that the Well connection/MCP "isn't working" or "nothing happened".

say_en.note: Claude will retrieve and summarize cash flow data
Claude will fetch invoice data from Well

say_en.text: Build my profit and loss statement for last quarter
say_en.note: Claude will call Well tools to generate P&L statement
